audience: HR and payroll teams that read payroll and time data from Talexio

useCases.title: Check who is on the payroll for a period
useCases.text: List the organisation units, then list the employees with their payroll fields for a pay period. Only positions with that pay frequency are returned.

useCases.title: Review approved pay lines for a week
useCases.text: Read the approved timesheet pay lines per employee for up to 92 days. The lines show hours, overtime, allowances and penalties. Times are in Europe/Malta.

useCases.title: See who is on approved leave
useCases.text: List approved leave in a date range of up to 366 days, so planners know who is away. Cancelled leave is left out unless you ask for it.

useCases.title: List shift templates for planning
useCases.text: List the shift templates your user can see, ordered by name, with their ids.
